deletion.notes: rgpd@ is the French RGPD contact. Article 17 erasure request must include proof of identity (per CNIL guidance). Contact email and playbook structure based on standard French data-broker opt-out patterns; live Art.17 verification pending.

playbook: Search the record on locasystem.fr (French phone/address directory).
Send Art. 17 erasure request to rgpd@locasystem.fr (French or English; French preferred for faster response).
Attach a copy of photo ID (per CNIL standard practice for first-time requests).
Expected response within 30 days per Art. 12(3). If no response, escalate to CNIL via pdd.py escalate.
quirks: French-only UI; English requests are accepted but processed more slowly.
ID requirement is firm — anonymous requests are rejected.
Listings may reappear from upstream phone directory aggregators; schedule re-scan.
